meta.title: A rejected bid can be put back to active while bidding is open
gaps: The status endpoint used to reject the bid and set its status to active is not specified by an available operation or an allowed request path, so steps 1 and 2 cannot be expressed.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
